messages.text:
The refund proposal is for **BRL 150.00**. It can only go to the order’s original payment method; I can’t redirect it to your new card, even though the old card was cancelled. Its issuer handles any credit, and the shop can’t promise where or when it appears (refund-policy/v2/payment).

The proposal is on your card. If you want to proceed with the original payment method, confirm the exact proposal using the button on the card—typing “yes” here won’t confirm it (refund-policy/v2/approval).
